title: CyberGuard - Malicious URL Detection
subtitle: Real-Time AI & Machine Learning Web Security System
summary: Real-time web security system using FastAPI backend, Python Machine Learning (Scikit-Learn Random Forest / TF-IDF classification NLP), and React UI for malicious link detection.

caseStudy.problem: Phishing threats utilize dynamic URL masking that traditional static blacklists miss.
caseStudy.research: Extracted 18 structural and lexical features from URL payloads (entropy, length, subdomain depth, TLD risk).
caseStudy.architecture: Stateless FastAPI microservice running pre-trained Scikit-Learn Random Forest model connected to React 19 client.
caseStudy.challenges: Maintaining sub-50ms inference latency during multi-threaded feature extraction.
caseStudy.solutions: Parallelized async feature extraction workers and model serialization optimization.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Feature vector optimization is paramount for low-latency security classification.

title: NexusHR-AI
subtitle: AI-Powered HR Tech & Candidate Evaluation Platform
summary: Next-gen intelligent human resources platform automating resume parsing, candidate scoring, and interview scheduling workflows using AI engines.

caseStudy.problem: Manual HR screening of hundreds of candidate resumes causes severe hiring bottlenecks.
caseStudy.research: Studied recruiter screening criteria across tech roles to build NLP keyword and experience matching vectors.
caseStudy.architecture: Next.js App Router front-end with Python processing services and PostgreSQL relational database.
caseStudy.challenges: Extracting structured JSON entities from multi-page PDFs and DOCX resumes cleanly.
caseStudy.solutions: Implemented rule-based regex parsing combined with document intelligence vectors.
caseStudy.performance: Reduced candidate screening time by over 80%.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Structured entity extraction is essential for modern recruitment automation.

title: ExpenseIQ - Secure Financial Dashboard
subtitle: Automated Personal Expense & Budget Intelligence System
summary: Secure financial dashboard and transaction analytics platform providing budget visualization, SQL data persistence, and category tracking.

caseStudy.problem: Users struggle with manual expense tracking and lack secure, encrypted financial analytics.
caseStudy.research: Designed normalized SQL database schema for double-entry ledger security and category aggregation.
caseStudy.architecture: Python backend API serving analytical endpoints to a responsive React Chart.js dashboard.
caseStudy.challenges: Optimizing relational aggregations over multi-year transaction datasets.
caseStudy.solutions: Applied composite database indexing and optimized SQL summary views.
caseStudy.performance: Instant dashboard rendering for 10,000+ transaction lines.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Relational schema indexing is critical for sub-10ms financial reporting.

title: CashFlow-IQ
subtitle: Intelligent Cash Flow Forecasting & Financial Utility
summary: Financial utility analyzing recurring income and expenditure patterns to generate predictive monthly cash flow forecasts.

caseStudy.problem: Small businesses and individuals lack accessible forward-looking cash flow projections.
caseStudy.research: Implemented moving average time series forecasting models over SQL transaction history.
caseStudy.architecture: Java backend service executing numerical calculation algorithms connected to SQL data store.
caseStudy.challenges: Handling erratic and non-periodic income events accurately.
caseStudy.solutions: Designed weighted moving average filters with outlier detection.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Algorithm selection directly impacts business decision utility.

title: Reactive-Resume Tailor
subtitle: Dynamic Resume Builder & Customizer
summary: Custom resume builder tool allowing live editing, section toggling, and export of ATS-optimized candidate resumes.

caseStudy.problem: Job seekers need job-specific resume variants without rebuilding documents from scratch.
caseStudy.research: Analyzed standard ATS document layout parser rules.
caseStudy.architecture: React state machine rendering real-time print styling preview.
caseStudy.challenges: Ensuring 100% page-break compliance during PDF printing.
caseStudy.solutions: Applied custom print CSS media query rules.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: CSS print media specifications require precise page box model controls.

title: Netflix Clone - Video Streaming Web Interface
subtitle: Responsive Media Catalog & UI Component System
summary: High-fidelity media streaming interface built with React, featuring dynamic movie category sliders, trailer previews, and responsive layouts.

caseStudy.problem: Creating smooth horizontal scroll carousels and dynamic video overlays without UI lag.
caseStudy.research: Studied Netflix web application design system and CSS scroll snap behaviors.
caseStudy.architecture: Modular React component hierarchy consuming movie catalog endpoints.
caseStudy.challenges: Optimizing image loading speed across high-density poster grids.
caseStudy.solutions: Implemented lazy loading and responsive image sources.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Media lazy loading improves web initial render time significantly.

title: Dynamic Weather Forecast Web App
subtitle: Real-Time Geospatial Weather Analytics UI
summary: Clean weather application fetching live meteorological data, hourly forecasts, and animated atmospheric condition visuals.

caseStudy.problem: Displaying multi-day weather trends cleanly across varying device screen sizes.
caseStudy.research: Designed glassmorphic weather cards with dynamic color palettes matching current weather state.
caseStudy.architecture: Vanilla JS client consuming OpenWeather REST API.
caseStudy.challenges: Graceful handling of API rate limits and geolocation permission denials.
caseStudy.solutions: Implemented fallback city search and client caching.
caseStudy.performance: Instant UI state transitions upon location update.
caseStudy.lessonsLearned: Graceful fallback UI improves user experience significantly.
